enum_occurrence_audit.resolution: Replace the mixed role, implementation-form, and artifact-role enum with registry entity_class plus schema-local role axes; remove other.
Split inference_usage from reproducibility_result; represent unknown through claim_status rather than a value.
Move to relation grain and split authority_status, runtime_use_status, and succession_status; omit non-applicable relations.
Remove with the determinism enum; inference detail is controlled by inference_usage in the owning relation schema.
Store desired cadence, applied trigger, and exercised cadence independently; compile matches or differs as a generated comparison.
Put authority_role on each declared relationship, not on the artifact globally; omit a relationship instead of using none.
Use in_place_mutable, append_only, whole_document_replace, or immutable on persisted artifacts; omit non-applicable artifacts.
Keep stable versus unstable as the value domain and carry unknown in claim_status.
Use a boolean observed value with independent claim_status and basis_mode.
Split assessment_completeness from fitness_status; conditions are records, not a QUALIFIED state.
Move disposition to its own manifest and split decision_status, retirement_action, and successor_status.
Use basis_mode observed, derived, or authority_declaration; use claim_status unknown instead of absent.
Remove row floors and free-key provenance maps; every atomic claim carries its own basis and evidence references.
